title: CmdPal: Add a new tray icon menu

confidence.rationale: Exact upstream type with JSON-deserialized duplicates reproduces the exception; literal candidate compiles and preserves focused persistence controls.

proposed_comments.title: Normalize duplicate persisted tray pins before reorder
proposed_comments.body:
**Severity: Medium — saved tray order cannot be updated when persisted pins contain duplicates.**

`Commands` currently accepts duplicate provider/command pairs from settings, while `RefreshAsync` shows only `pins.Distinct()`. `Reorder` therefore receives fewer visible entries than there are matching saved slots and advances `next` past the end. The focused exact-source JSON regression reproduces this exception. `SaveOrder` catches/logs it and sets `HasLoadError`; it does not crash the process.

**If left unchanged:** a settings list with duplicate pins can display normally but fail every drag-to-reorder attempt, leaving the order unsaved.

Normalize persisted pairs at initialization, preserving first-occurrence order and the existing null-to-empty behavior:

```suggestion
        init => _commands = value?.Distinct().ToImmutableList() ?? [];
```

Add a JSON regression containing repeated visible pins separated by an unavailable pin; confirm reorder succeeds and the unavailable pin keeps its position. The literal replacement compiled with the unmodified persistence type and passed 12 focused checks; the original passed 11 controls including reproduction of the duplicate-pin failure. These are isolated persistence checks, not a complete CmdPal build or interactive drag test.
